purpose: Teach: 乗り込む/やって来る/得よ/上質/ニュースレター/上乗せ/不可避/初旬

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、新市場に、絶対、乗り込む覚悟で、進めたぞ、お父さんの覚悟、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, I went into new markets with absolute resolve — your father's determination. I'm asking you to carry that seriousness forward.
lines.style: Measured, deep voice. Opens with quiet weight. Pauses after 'founding days' as if summoning memory. Even pace, each phrase given room to land. Closes with gentle but unmistakable gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、お得意様、絶対、やって来る、絶対、流れ、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, the trust of our valued customers has continued to flow. I'm truly grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Clear but not brisk. Each clause spoken as acknowledgment, not recitation. The gratitude sits underneath, genuine, not performed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、利益を、絶対、得ようと、絶対、必死だったぞ、お父さん、お前にも、絶対、伝えたい、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, we were desperate to turn a profit — and I want you to understand that hunger, that necessity. I'm asking you to remember it.
lines.style: Voice carries the weight of lean years. Slower now, almost confiding. A slight rasp of old effort. Trails into the request with quiet insistence, like a trust being placed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、上質な、絶対、製品、絶対、引き継いでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've been careful — choosing quality over quick gains. I intend to honor that same standard.
lines.style: Formal but warm. 'Quality' given gentle emphasis. Voice carries the shape of a promise made to someone not here. Steady resolve underneath the courtesy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、ニュースレター、絶対、お父さん、絶対、手書きで、絶対、書いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, your father wrote our newsletter by hand — every letter. That's the kind of care I'm asking you not to forget.
lines.style: Slight wonder in the opening, remembering. Softens on 'by hand.' The voice carries the image of pen and paper. Closes with weight, not heaviness — this matters.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、価格に、絶対、上乗せ、絶対、慎重だった、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we've never rushed a price increase — never taken the easy margin. I'm grateful for that restraint, and I'll maintain it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Almost formal in its respect for the principle being stated. No haste in the delivery. The gratitude is steady, the commitment even steadier.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業の変化、本気で、絶対、不可避、絶対、お父さんの代でも、絶対、何度もあったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Change came to us even in the founding days — it was unavoidable even for your father. We faced it many times. You will too.
lines.style: Slower, more deliberate. A kind of gentle instruction. Not pessimistic — factual. Pauses after 'many times' to let that reality settle in the listener's mind.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。月の初旬、本気で、絶対、お父さんの墓参り、絶対、毎月、絶対、行ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. On the first of every month, I visit your father's grave. I'll continue to do that. That gratitude doesn't end.
lines.style: Quiet, almost liturgical. Voice carries the ritual of it — something done with deliberate care, month after month. Closes with absolute simplicity. A vow, not a statement.
